stem.text: A student investigated the effect of substrate concentration on the rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction. A graph was plotted to show the relationship between these two variables. The student was asked to take readings from the graph that could be used to determine the Michaelis–Menten constant, $K_\text{m}$, for this enzyme.
J, K, L and M show points read from the graphs which the student could use to determine the value of $K_\text{m}$.

stem.alt: Graph of rate of reaction against concentration of substrate, with the label J on the vertical axis at a dashed reference line.
Graph of rate of reaction against concentration of substrate, with the label K on the horizontal axis at a dashed reference line.
Graph of rate of reaction against concentration of substrate, with the label L on the vertical axis at a dashed reference line.
Graph of rate of reaction against concentration of substrate, with the label M on the horizontal axis at a dashed reference line.
